annotations.text:
LOADING SCREEN — animates live, on a 9s loop.

The ring strokes itself on like a stamp pressed into a label, then the five things focaccia is made of arrive in turn — Farina, Acqua, Olio d'Oliva, Sale, Tempo — while a dimple presses into the dough for each one. That row of dimples IS the progress bar.

Behind it, a Tuscan courtyard photograph sunk under a burgundy wash. Sugar Haus types a terminal; this proofs dough.

OWN IDENTITY, not a Sugar Haus reskin.

Type: Bodoni Moda — the Italian didone — with EB Garamond and Italianno. Sugar Haus uses Playfair/Lora/Work Sans.

Anatomy: centred label masthead, oval cartouches, an enamel market sign, a bill of fare with dotted leaders, vertical spine rails. Sugar Haus uses a left-logo navbar and centred card grids.

Palette is the logo's: burgundy #8E1B1B, olive #4E6023, gold #B8862F, paper #F4EFE2.

The standing menu prices are shared from menu.json. Remaining client confirmations are the market schedule/address, delivery and shipping boundaries, allergen/organic wording, and final brand photography.
